market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain volatile into the RBA decision. Banks and gold support the index, but iron ore weakness, petrol shock, and Qantas strike risk cap upside. Expect ^AXJO to trade in a narrow range with elevated VIX. AUD/USD pressured by 5% global yields.
market_outlook.long_term: Rising 2027 recession odds and IMF fiscal warnings suggest a growth slowdown within 12 months. Structural positives (AI capex, gold, energy transition) offer selective opportunities, but broad-market upside is constrained by rate pressure and commodity softness. A rotation from cyclicals to defensives is the base case.
